title: Map of the Fatline
caption: The world, as the keepers drew it.
prompt:
An antique hand-drawn map on aged parchment, sepia ink line work with light watercolour, in the manner of an old explorer's chart, with fine construction lines and a compass rose.

The scene: A map of a world of small islands floating in a sea of clouds, connected by thin dotted lines of light. A blue river winds through the islands on the left and a pink river through the islands on the right, never touching. Tiny drawn ruins, aqueducts, towers and a round amphitheatre are scattered over the islands, with very small sketched round-headed figurines here and there. The compass rose in the corner is a small round stone head with a line across its forehead. A short, neatly lettered title at the top reads exactly: THE FATLINE. A few small hand-lettered place names, spelled exactly: SNAPCHAIN beside the blue river, HYPERSNAP beside the pink river, THE VAULT beside a fountain, THE ARCHIVE beside a cliff library, HALL OF 777 beside the amphitheatre. No other text.
